service.description: getAccountHub (PASS Account/Home): the signed-in account's cards from the apps the site mounts that register one (PublicApps accountCard: Shop, Billing, Support), each asked in its own transaction (one that fails says so and the others show), and its account links. SIGN_IN_REQUIRED for a visitor.

getEmailPreferences (PASS Account/EmailPreferences): by a list link's token, its list and the party's other lists of that organization (read only, so a mail scanner changes nothing); for the signed-in account, its current lists, the site's store topics (each store's cart reminders and review requests, a choice waiting for confirmation marked) and the Forum opt-out's page; by a receipt's confirm code, the checkout's optional emails (read only). A verified account's checkout choices of its email waiting for confirmation are confirmed on opening it.

storeEmailPreferences: by a list link's token, the lists chosen or all marketing email (apply#UnsubscribePreferences); for the signed-in account, lists unsubscribed and the store topics turned on or off (store#PartyConsent, purpose PcpCartReminder or PcpReviewRequest on the store's topic list; on needs the account's email verified); by a receipt's confirm code with choices.confirm, the checkout's pending optional emails granted. Answers the preferences after.
applyOneClickUnsubscribe: RFC 8058's one-click POST to a list link: the token's list unsubscribed.

Whether a party turned on a store's cart reminders on its email preferences (its latest PcpCartReminder consent on the store's topic list is a grant); never for a party with no account (a guest). Commerce's cart recovery requires it (impl-commerce P10).

Whether a party has a store's review requests on (its latest PcpReviewRequest consent on the store's topic list is a grant), from the email preferences page or a confirmed checkout opt-in. The review request's delivery checks the same consent at its hand-off (queue#Delivery's consentContactListId).

Internal (StoreTopics.js, one opt-in in a transaction of its own): a checkout party's opt-in (reviewRequests, cartReminders or news) of a store, pending (a CLPT_PENDING membership of its list, never sent to) or granted (the topic's PartyConsent on its list, or the news list's subscription). outcome: pending, granted or already.

parameter.name: requirePending
parameter.description: A confirmation: grant only a choice still pending (else outcome withdrawn)

service.description: For the order receipt (send#OrderStoreEmail's PsetOrderPlaced): a Shop order whose checkout has an opt-in waiting for confirmation gets a new one-time code (only its digest kept) and the site's email preferences link carrying it; any other order, or a site without an Account mount, gets none.
